title: Implement durable scheduling, queue, retry, and dead-letter delivery
businessObjective: Advance Phase 3 — Durable event and workflow layer through one bounded event-delivery outcome.
technicalObjective: Implement durable scheduling and queue consumption with bounded retry, safe requeue, dead-letter handling, deduplication, and recorded failure reasons independent of any AI provider.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: No production write, deployment, or live credential access is authorized.
Interfaces with the finalized platform use approved compatibility contracts only.
acceptanceCriteria: Scheduled checks and normalized events produce durable, deduplicated queue work without relying on Codex or a model as scheduler.
Retry, safe requeue, exhaustion, and dead-letter transitions are bounded, deterministic, observable, and preserve task and failure reason.
Unavailable providers cannot drop work, bypass policy, or cause production execution.
Required tests pass and independent verification confirms forbidden paths were untouched.
solEscalationTriggers: Any required change crosses declared subsystem or protected paths.
Any production access, credential, payment, booking, RLS, migration, authorization, concurrency, or workflow-correctness ambiguity arises.
rollbackExpectations: Revert the event-delivery branch and generated artifacts; preserve audit and verification evidence.
